# AI Operations Reliability Lab

> Public synthetic portfolio project by Vinicius Castello Branco. It demonstrates
> reliable AI operations through executable code and tests. It is not connected to an
> employer, customer, or production system.

## Core capabilities

- Deterministic commit barrier for AI-proposed responses and actions.
- Human ownership lock with one-time, integrity-bound handoff notice.
- Idempotency and intent/action consistency.
- Required confirmation before simulated sensitive effects.
- Privacy-aware JSONL audit with SHA-256 hash-chain verification.
- Structured operational metrics and health status.
- PowerShell-based Windows infrastructure health snapshot.
- Deterministic regression suite with no external API calls.

## Primary evidence

- README.md
- src/ai_ops_reliability/policy.py
- src/ai_ops_reliability/pipeline.py
- src/ai_ops_reliability/audit.py
- tests/test_pipeline.py
- scenarios/demo.jsonl
- scripts/windows-health-check.ps1
- skills.json

## Scope

All scenarios and data are fictional. The repository makes no claim of production use,
customer results, employer affiliation, or ownership of a commercial product.
